VERSATILE EVERYDAY WARDROBE
Styling Ideas & Capsule Combinations
Effortless elegance designed to pair with existing wardrobe staples across seasons
LOOK 01 · SUMMER CHIC
Minimalist Resort & Beach
Pair Margot in washed Sage Olive linen with a fitted ribbed ivory tank top, leather slide sandals, and woven straw tote for effortless warm-weather sophistication.
LOOK 02 · OFFICE CASUAL
Relaxed Tailored Workwear
Tuck a crisp oversized white linen button-down into the high waist, add a fine leather belt effect, and complete with tailored leather loafers for breezy office comfort.
LOOK 03 · AUTUMN TRANSITION
Cozy Weekend Layering
Style Margot in medium-weight cotton twill with a cropped cashmere sweater, denim jacket, and clean minimalist white sneakers for relaxed weekend strolls.

FABRIC CARE GUIDELINE
Machine wash cold on gentle cycle with mild detergent. Hang to dry or tumble dry low. Press with a warm steam iron while slightly damp for that signature crisp luxury linen texture.
